name: Quietus
description: A twelve-solar-mass silence orbited by a single scorched rock and long-falling comets. The accretion flow burns faintly, a quiescent whisper beside hungrier holes. Time itself runs measurably slow near the inner orbits.

stars.name: Quietus Dark
stars.description: A stellar-mass singularity wrapped in a thin faint disk, currently between meals. Lensing rings the empty point where the horizon sits. Clocks on close orbits lag the sector standard.

planets.name: Lastlight
planets.description: An iron planet skimming the edge of the shadow, its sky bent into permanent Einstein rings. Tidal forces knead the interior hot despite the cold starlight. Chronometer stations here calibrate deep-space clocks.

comets.name: Falling Silence
comets.description: A long-period comet on a decaying path toward the horizon. Each return sheds light bent into arcs around the dark. One passage soon will be its last, and scopes are booked solid.

comets.name: Grazing Prayer
comets.description: A sungrazer threading the photon sphere's neighborhood and surviving, barely. Its tail lenses into a perfect halo at perihelion. Pilgrim scopes gather for every passage like a festival.
